correctness.rationale: The recurrence modulo 17 gives the exact 8-cycle 0,1,6,1,0,-1,-6,-1. The power sequence has least period 8 (odd e) or 4 (even e). All window sums zero forces the window length to be a period; conversely eight-block cancellations or the four-block total 2+6^e give exact sufficient conditions. The exact order of 6 modulo17 is 16 and 6^10=-2. Full unrestricted proof and independent finite checker 38400 parameter pairs, not replacing proof.

value.rationale: 17 is the unique rank-4 prime appearing in the natural balancing recurrence B_4=204. The theorem gives a complete two-parameter local prime support classification and identifies the first even-exponent resonance at e=10, providing a precise obstruction to exponent-stable extrapolation of published square-power GCD work and a necessary test for future complete higher-power formulas.
